signal.label: SELL
signal.buyer: Avoid buying now - wait for a dip.
signal.holder: Consider selling a part to book profit.

evidence.value: Forecast Rs 1,65,860 (-10.7%) vs bank interest 0.6% -> edge -11.3%
evidence.test: edge >= +3%: +2 | >= +1%: +1 | <= -1%: -1 | <= -3%: -2 (capped at 1 point: backtest error 11.4% is not better than no-change 10.1%)
evidence.source: Dharalu forecast (backtest error 11.37% vs no-change 10.05%, 244 tests)
evidence.why: Holding metal only pays if the expected rise beats the interest the money would earn.

evidence.value: Prices in Dec are usually -0.7% vs Oct (after removing the long trend)
evidence.source: Seasonal index from 9 years of prices (82% weight, rest = no season)
evidence.why: Indian demand peaks around Dhanteras, Diwali and the wedding season; world demand around Chinese New Year.

evidence.value: 7-day avg Rs 1,83,260 vs 30-day avg Rs 1,97,268; 30-day change -14.3%
evidence.source: World price x Rs rate (Yahoo Finance)
evidence.why: Prices tend to keep moving the way they are moving for a few weeks.

evidence.value: Price Rs 1,85,651 vs 200-day avg Rs 2,28,857; 50-day avg Rs 2,07,151
evidence.test: price and 50-day both above the 200-day: +1 | both below: -1
evidence.source: World price x Rs rate, last ~9 months
evidence.why: Metals move in long waves; going with the big trend avoids fighting it.

evidence.value: Today is higher than 17% of the last year's days (range Rs 1,39,020 - Rs 3,57,960)
evidence.source: World price x Rs rate, last 365 days
evidence.why: Buying in the cheap part of the yearly range limits risk.

evidence.source: World price x Rs rate, last 14 trading days
evidence.why: A very fast rise/fall often pauses or reverses.

evidence.value: Rs 94.92 per US$ vs Rs 95.80 a month ago (-0.9%)
evidence.why: Metal is priced in dollars: a falling rupee makes it dearer in India, a rising one cheaper.

evidence.value: 1 oz of gold buys 72.0 oz of silver
evidence.test: >= 85: +1 (silver cheap vs gold) | <= 65: -1 (silver dear vs gold)
evidence.why: Over the long run the ratio swings around ~65-85; at the extremes silver tends to catch up or lag.

forecast_reason.summary: Expected to fall about 10.7% in 30 days. Biggest reason: recent trend (-9.8%).
forecast_reason.telugu: 30 రోజుల్లో సుమారు 10.7% తగ్గవచ్చు. ప్రధాన కారణం: ఇటీవలి ధోరణి (-9.8%).

drivers.name: Recent trend
drivers.why: Over the last 30 days the price fell 14.3% once the usual seasonal effect is taken out. The forecast carries that direction forward but lets it fade each day, so about 65% of it is kept over the next 30 days.

drivers.name: Season
drivers.why: In the seasonal pattern (from 9 years of prices) the price is usually 0.5% lower in 30 days' time (Nov) than now (Oct).

drivers.name: Last few days' average
drivers.why: Today's price is above the last 5 days' average, and the forecast counts a one-day jump only half, so it starts 0.5% lower than today.

forecast_reason.range: 80% of past misses fell inside -23.6% to +9.1% at 30 days, so that is the likely range.
forecast_reason.trust: Tested on 244 past dates: off by 11.4% on average at 30 days, vs 10.1% for "price stays the same" - it is NOT better than no-change here, so read it as a range, not a number. Direction right 55% of the time.
forecast_reason.blind: It reads only the price's own trend and season. It can't see US interest-rate moves, war or crisis news, central-bank buying, or an import-duty change in the Budget - news like that can move the price outside the range.
